query: INSERT INTO odoo_identity (user_id, odoo_login, odoo_uid, odoo_api_key_encrypted) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET odoo_login = EXCLUDED.odoo_login, odoo_uid = EXCLUDED.odoo_uid, odoo_api_key_encrypted = EXCLUDED.odoo_api_key_encrypted, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
